message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated September 22-28, 2014, features a light blue background with a red vertical border on the left. The masthead "TEMPO" is centered in large, dark blue serif font. Above it, white text reads: "AKAL-AKALAN IMPOR MINYAK", "KETUA KPK: TAK ADA KENDALA PANGGIL MEGA", and "KURSI MENTERI KOALISI JOKOWI". Below the masthead, the headline "HEBOH RAPAT 18 TRILIUN" is printed in large white sans-serif blocks.

The central scene depicts four identical dark-colored luxury sedans or limousines arranged in a circle around a large, round, light blue table. The table has several rectangular white and yellow papers scattered on its surface. Four men in dark suits and white shirts emerge from the sunroofs of the cars to participate in a meeting around the table.

On the upper left, a man sits upright with hands folded. To the upper right, a man reclines with his hands behind his head. On the lower left, a man works on a laptop placed on the roof of his car. On the lower right, a man rests his elbows on the car roof, looking toward the table. Martini glasses sit on the roofs near three of the men. A barcode and price "RP 35.000" are in the bottom left.
